title: Parquet de Vallonne opens inquiry after scellés vanish from the sealed-evidence room
content: The procureur de la République of Vallonne has opened an *enquête préliminaire* after a routine inventory found that four sealed boxes (*scellés*) from a narcotics case had disappeared from the tribunal’s evidence room. The boxes, sealed in March, contained cash and two telephones that were to be examined by the laboratory.

The president of the tribunal ordered an administrative audit of the room’s registers, which record every entry since 2018. According to a magistrate briefed on the audit, the last signature for the four boxes dates from June and does not correspond to any scheduled *transport* to the laboratory.

The syndicat de la magistrature called for the publication of the room’s camera logs and warned that “the credibility of the chain of custody is the credibility of the institution”. The parquet declined to comment on whether a *juge d’instruction* would be appointed, saying only that the inquiry was “in its first hours”.
author: Paul Rémond, reporter — Agence Continentale
